The chart uses `ActionMenuButton2` in five action-button components, plus one test that mocks it. Each component renders the button directly, so a behaviour change in the framework component (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/workspaces2/action-menu2/action-menu-button2.component.tsx`) would reach all of them. The most exposed are the ones that pass `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch` or `tagContent`, since those depend on launch and badge behaviour. The clinical-forms test asserts on the rendered label, so it would catch rendering changes.

1. **Visit note button**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/visit-note-action-button.extension.tsx` (lines 16-24). Passes `workspaceToLaunch` and `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch`.
2. **Clinical forms button**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.component.tsx` (lines 17-25). Passes `workspaceToLaunch` and `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch`.
3. **Order basket button**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket-action-button/order-basket-action-button.component.tsx` (lines 22-31). Passes `tagContent`, `workspaceToLaunch` with `windowProps`, and `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch`.
4. **Patient lists button**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-lists-app/src/action-button/patient-lists-action-button.extension.tsx` (lines 9-15). Passes `workspaceToLaunch` only.
5. **Task list button**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-task-list-app/src/launch-button/task-list-launch-button.extension.tsx` (lines 9-16). Passes `workspaceToLaunch` only.
6. **Clinical forms test**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.test.tsx`. Mocks `ActionMenuButton2` (lines 8-15) and asserts on the rendered label (lines 26-49).

I did not look at the workspace or extension registrations in the routes files, since they reference the components by name rather than the framework symbol.
